Under the ChargeBearer element, the parties that can bear charges are indicated by these codes: Borne By Debtor, Borne By Creditor, Shared, and Following Service Level [1]. The element is mandatory (1..1) [1].

The transaction status element (FIToFIPmtStsRpt/TxInfAndSts/TxSts) specifies the status of a transaction, as published in an external payment transaction status code list [1]. Its type is ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus1Code, it is optional (occurrence 0..1), and it sits under Transaction Information And Status, which holds information about the original transactions the status report refers to [1].

The creditor agent in pacs.008 is the financial institution servicing an account for the creditor [1]. It is located at Credit Transfer Transaction Information > Creditor Agent (XML path: FIToFICstmrCdtTrf/CdtTrfTxInf/CdtrAgt), with type BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification8 and occurrence 1..1 (mandatory) [1].

The maximum length of the message identification in pacs.008 is 35 characters. The element is typed as Max35Text, with 1 to 35 characters [1].

All occurrences of Credit Transfer Transaction Information / Interbank Settlement Amount must have the same currency as Group Header / Total Interbank Settlement Amount, when the Total Interbank Settlement Amount is present [1].

It sits under Credit Transfer Transaction Information > Settlement Time Request, at XML path FIToFICstmrCdtTrf/CdtTrfTxInf/SttlmTmReq/RjctTm [1].

However, the same passage notes that the Cover Method code was retired in 2025 and that only Clearing System remains valid [1]. So the current valid option is Clearing System [1].
The maximum length of the message identification (MsgId) in pacs.008 is 35 characters. It is of type Max35Text, which is text of 1 to 35 characters, with mandatory occurrence 1..1 [1].
